# Scalize Systems

> Operational systems for companies scaling faster than their processes can support. Scalize Systems helps pre-seed through Series C growth-stage companies build, optimize, and scale systems.

Scalize Systems was founded by Katie Robblee, whose background spans product management, product operations, technical program management, and engineering management. The work: building scalable processes, designing decision frameworks, and helping teams figure out where AI adds value and where humans need to stay in the loop.

Engagements:
- Operating Diagnostic (two to three weeks): maps how an organization operates, where effort is going, and where the friction is. Deliverables are a Process Alignment Map, a Decision Friction Audit, and a Prioritized Recommendation Roadmap.
- Build Engagement (three to six months): scoped directly from the diagnostic findings, producing processes and frameworks and a plan to scale them with the company.

Contact: katie@scalizesystems.com, or book a free 15-minute consultation at https://www.scalizesystems.com/contact

## Templates and Tools

- [AI RACI for Product and Engineering Teams](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/z13orr0o/production/e3700eaa228aefc594f0765fbe83d9c2d4116d54.xlsx): This RACI template gives teams a way to negotiate ownership over the roles AI has reshaped, from reviewing AI-generated code to catching a hallucination before it ships. It gives facilitators a starting list of jobs and allows teams to visualize where ownership is still unclaimed.
- [Graduated Human-in-the-Loop Eval Ownership Model](https://cdn.sanity.io/files/z13orr0o/production/2985dbcae89550c626f230d169000fccc4392002.pdf): This framework gives senior PMs a structured approach for reintroducing that friction deliberately, through human-in-the-loop evaluation work. It gives junior PMs a clear picture of what is expected at each stage and what evidence demonstrates readiness to advance. It gives organizational leaders a model for what skill-building in an AI-native product team actually requires.
